topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative opening, course framing, and primary learning outcomes for the cancer biology lecture series.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of cellular differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological basis of cancer as a progressive breakdown in normal genetic regulation, cellular differentiation, and tissue architecture, along with experimental models used to study it.

topics.label: Tumour invasion, metastasis, and histological progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the clinical and histological distinctions between benign and malignant tumours, focusing on local invasion through basement membranes, metastatic spread, and stepwise progression from precursor lesions.

topics.label: Tumour classification, nomenclature, and systemic morbidity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the naming conventions and behavioural classifications of tumours alongside the mechanical and physiological mechanisms by which they produce morbidity and mortality.

topics.label: Epidemiology and comparative oncology across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyse patterns of tumour incidence and mortality in human populations and across diverse multicellular animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening strategies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the signs of tumour presentation and evaluate the rationale, histological indicators, and practical effectiveness of population screening programmes.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical session reminders
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the closing housekeeping remarks, concluding the session and previewing upcoming practical work.
